name: Downfall [Sandbox]
desc:
Thanks for waiting!
HOW TO PLAY MOBILE:
Sadly currently the game has no mobile support but
you can play with a controller connected to your mobile device

What's new?
Titans now have armor
ODM tweaked abit
small bug fixes

MISSIONS:
https://www.roblox.com/games/787206414/AoT-Downfall-Missions

Controls:
[ ] means controller
Q/E [RT/LT] - Hooks
WASD [Left Analog Stick] - Air and Ground movement
Space [LB] - Gas Boost
R [RB] - Reload blades
X [Dpad down] - Flare
P [Dpad right] - Back to menu
H [Dpad left] - Spawn or Ride your horse
[RT] - Interact with gas supply

Credits
Mustaccio - Animations
Tzui - Horse
